levels.2: its own model: own crown, branching and foliage (plants) or own mesh (animals), not animated
levels.3: rigged and animated (animals); grown: three or more age classes and four seasons' colours (plants)
levels.4: full: behaviour, sound and seasonal states (animals); the ecology, habitat and relations (plants)
